_meta.purpose: Confirms the shape of GitHub's native Stacked-PRs GraphQL fields (PullRequest.stack, PullRequest.stackEntry), a private-preview feature (bead pg2-4dz88.3.3).
_meta.source: GraphQL schema introspection against github.com (__type queries on PullRequest, PullRequestStack, PullRequestStackEntry, PullRequestStackEntryConnection), run 2026-08-24. Both fields confirmed present on the PullRequest type.
_meta.note: Every value below is SYNTHETIC. No real repository, pull request, branch, or account was queried or is represented here -- the field shape is identical for any account regardless of the underlying data, so introspection alone is sufficient to pin it. No redaction was required because no real data was ever read.
